# AI data centers are scaling fast. Let's build them the right way.

Water is at the heart of AI. You need water to produce chips, to power them, and to cool them. There
is no AI without water. And today, that matters more than ever.

## protecting people and the resources vital to life.

People Health

Helping people thrive by protecting their individual health, the food they eat and the spaces where
they live and work.

Planet Health

Helping the planet thrive by protecting the earth's climate and its most valuable resource: water.

Business Health

Helping businesses thrive by protecting their reputations and their bottom line.

eROI is the exponential return on investment that comes from improved performance, operational
efficiency and sustainable impact. By tracking Total Value Delivered of Ecolab solutions, our
customers see how they are achieving their sustainability and business goals together. Interact with
our eROI counter to see how much water, energy, waste and air is positively impacted by customers
using our technologies.

* # SC Johnson Announces Local Production of Dengue Prevention Tool in Argentina
  
  SC Johnson dedicated a new high-speed manufacturing line in Pilar, Argentina, to produce SC
  Johnson Guardian™, a dengue prevention tool. The new line will have the capacity to produce up to
  20 million units annually, helping expand access to dengue prevention tools across the region.

* # New Partnership between SC Johnson, U.S. Department of State and the Global Fund
  
  The collaboration between SC Johnson, U.S. Department of State and the Global Fund expected to

  helping protect more than 60 million people over three years.

* # Good Morning America visits SC Johnson in Racine, Wisconsin
  
  ABC’s Good Morning America (GMA) recently visited SC Johnson’s world headquarters in Racine,

Our Recent Stories

Our Purpose


For more than 130 years, SC Johnson has been guided by the same goal as families everywhere: We want
to make the world a better place for the next generation.

That’s the foundation of our purpose – A Family Company at Work for a Better World. We believe a
more sustainable, healthier and transparent world that inspires people and creates opportunities
isn’t just possible, it’s our responsibility.

It starts with our long legacy of beloved brands and high-quality products that make life better for
families, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide.

But it’s also about bringing our expertise in science, innovation and partnerships to bear on some
of the world’s most pressing environmental and health issues, like reducing plastic waste and
eradicating malaria.

Led by the same family for five generations, SC Johnson and its people are at work for families
everywhere. Earning and keeping your goodwill means the world to us.

## Reducing plastic pollution

We’re innovating to reduce plastic in our products, raising awareness about plastic waste and
advocating to improve recycling around the globe.

[
Learn more
][13]
[A hand picks up a plastic bottle from grass in a sunlit outdoor setting, with a person kneeling
nearby.]

## Protecting families from insect-borne disease

With our decades of insect science expertise, we’re bringing new strategies and innovations to the
fight against insect-borne diseases like malaria and dengue.

Learn more

Our Recent Stories

Our Purpose


For more than 130 years, SC Johnson has been guided by the same goal as families everywhere: We want
to make the world a better place for the next generation.

That’s the foundation of our purpose – A Family Company at Work for a Better World. We believe a
more sustainable, healthier and transparent world that inspires people and creates opportunities
isn’t just possible, it’s our responsibility.

It starts with our long legacy of beloved brands and high-quality products that make life better for
families, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide.

But it’s also about bringing our expertise in science, innovation and partnerships to bear on some
of the world’s most pressing environmental and health issues, like reducing plastic waste and
eradicating malaria.

Led by the same family for five generations, SC Johnson and its people are at work for families
everywhere. Earning and keeping your goodwill means the world to us.

## Reducing plastic pollution

We’re innovating to reduce plastic in our products, raising awareness about plastic waste and
advocating to improve recycling around the globe.

**A smarter approach to surface cleaning starts here: **Introducing a fast, convenient alternative
to linen rags for cleaning hard, nonporous surfaces.
Quick. Responsible. Ready when you need them. Because clean and green can’t wait.

[ Learn More ][169]

## THE SANI PROFESSIONAL **ADVANTAGE**

[Waitress Cleaning a table with Sani Professional Wipes]

## Clean Confidently

We believe your success depends on confidence: confidence that your facility is safe and spotless;
confidence that your staff is cleaning and sanitizing the right way; confidence that your guests are
satisfied, and your brand is secure.

Sani Professional puts that confidence in the palm of your hand—by reinventing the way you clean and
sanitize. Discover innovative solutions that take the complexity out of compliance, help stretch
your budgets further, and protect the health of your staff and patrons. We make it easy, fast, and
effective so you can be confident that food safety is a seamless part of a satisfying
experience—where you, your employees, and your customers win, every day.

## Sanitize Effectively

Commercial food and business establishments face major challenges when it comes to cleaning,
sanitizing, and disinfecting. Too many products, too many steps, and not enough time increases the
risk of unsafe food and surroundings.

At Sani Professional, we understand you. Our goal is to help you protect your reputation with
convenient cleaning methods that are proven effective, compliant, and user-friendly. No mixing or
measuring is required. Plus, we have color-coded our lineup to ensure straightforward training,
proper use and ease of storage.

**A smarter approach to surface cleaning starts here: **Introducing a fast, convenient alternative

## THE SANI PROFESSIONAL **ADVANTAGE**

[Waitress Cleaning a table with Sani Professional Wipes]

## Clean Confidently

We believe your success depends on confidence: confidence that your facility is safe and spotless;
confidence that your staff is cleaning and sanitizing the right way; confidence that your guests are
satisfied, and your brand is secure.

Sani Professional puts that confidence in the palm of your hand—by reinventing the way you clean and
sanitize. Discover innovative solutions that take the complexity out of compliance, help stretch
your budgets further, and protect the health of your staff and patrons. We make it easy, fast, and
effective so you can be confident that food safety is a seamless part of a satisfying
experience—where you, your employees, and your customers win, every day.

## Sanitize Effectively

Commercial food and business establishments face major challenges when it comes to cleaning,
sanitizing, and disinfecting. Too many products, too many steps, and not enough time increases the
risk of unsafe food and surroundings.

At Sani Professional, we understand you. Our goal is to help you protect your reputation with
convenient cleaning methods that are proven effective, compliant, and user-friendly. No mixing or
measuring is required. Plus, we have color-coded our lineup to ensure straightforward training,
proper use and ease of storage.

##### Vizyon

Toplam kalite yönetimi ve müşteri memnuniyeti felsefesinden yola çıkarak, ıslak mendil ve diğer
sağlık ürünleri konusunda lider konuma ulaşmak ve ülkenin saygın firmaları arasında yer almaktadır.

Firmamızın ulusal ve uluslararası pazarda etkinliğini artırmak amacıyla devamlı yenilik ve kolaylık
sağlayacak kaliteli ürünler geliştirip müşterinin isteği doğrultusunda ihtiyaçlarını karşılayarak
dünyada güvenilir ve saygın bir kuruluş olmak ve ülkemizi en iyi şekilde temsil etmek en önemli
vizyonumuzdur.

##### Misyon

Hedefimiz; değerli çalışanlarımız ile birlikte koşulsuz müşteri memnuniyetini sağlamak, kültürel
değerlerimiz ve uluslararası kalite standartları çerçevesinde üretim yaparak dünya çapında güvenilir
ve seçkin bir Türk markası olarak anılmak.

Tedarikçileri kalite sisteminin bütünü içeresinde değerlendirip hep birlikte sürekli iyileştirmeyi
amaçlamak, teknolojik gelişmeleri takip etmek ve uygulamak, mümkün olduğu ölçüde çevre dostu
malzemeleri satmak ve çevreye saygılı olmak şirketimizin ana misyonudur.

# Certainty Brands - A Full Line of Hygiene Solutions

 We specialize in helping you find the right system to suit your needs.
Our cGMP manufacturing facility produces wipes products that are authorized for sale by Health
Canada, EPA, and FDA. Strict quality control measures allow us to ensure regulatory compliance and
guarantee you receive the highest quality products. 

### [Wipes & Refills][61]

Multi-surface disinfecting, sanitizing, personal care and specialty wipes. Available in canisters or
as refills to be used with our dispensers.
[ See Products ][62]

### [Hand Care][63]

Soaps and sanitizers that help prevent the spread of germs in your space. Available in pump bottles
or as refills cartridges.
[ See Products ][64]

### [Stands & Dispensers][65]

Modern, durable wipe and hand care dispensers to complement your space.  

[ See Products ][66]

## Why Choose Certainty Brands

We ensure product excellence and the best customer experience with every item we sell.

### Fragrance Free

We create fragrance-free formulas that help promote a scent-free work environment.

### Wipes Authorized for Sale by Health Canada

Many of our wipes formulas gently clean while killing 99.9% of germs.

### Innovation

We are dedicated to developing industry-leading formulations that exceed customer expectations

### Made in Canada

All our products are manufactured in Canada using only the highest quality materials.

### We are the Canadian industry leader in large format wipe solutions.

personal hygiene, pet care, industrial cleaning, and flushable applications.

Our state-of-the-art facility with ISO and FSC certifications enables monthly production of

[Contract Manufacturing][38]

**Advancing Eco-Friendly Living with Bamboo Wet Wipes.**

From wholesale biodegradable baby wipes and flushable adult wet wipes, to private-label pet wipes
and industrial cleaning wipes, we offer full-spectrum solutions that balance performance, safety,
and sustainability.

 

### Join the Green Hygiene Movement

Ready to elevate your brand with custom-branded eco-friendly wet wipes? **[Download our product
catalog][40]** or request a free sample today. [Contact us][41] — let’s create a cleaner future
together.
[Sywipe][42]® — your strategic partner for high-quality, sustainable wet wipes manufacturing.

  Adult Care Wipes are specially formulated wipes that provide gentle, effective cleansing and

  ### Pet Care Wipes
  
  Pet Care Wipes are gentle, safe cleaning wipes designed to keep pets clean and fresh, perfect for
  paws, fur, and sensitive skin.
* Disinfectant Wipes
  
  ### Disinfectant Wipes
  
  Disinfectant Wipes are powerful, convenient cleaning tools that effectively kill germs and
  bacteria on surfaces, ensuring a hygienic environment.
* Industrial Wipes
  
  ### Industrial Wipes
  
  Industrial Wipes are durable, absorbent cleaning solutions designed for heavy-duty tasks,
  providing efficient surface cleaning and maintenance in various industrial settings.

### Baby Cleaning Wipes

Pure natural formula, without any irritating ingredients, suitable for baby's delicate skin, to give
full cleaning and care, suitable for daily use for all the babies.

ingredient breaks down odor-producing substances for long-lasting freshness and comfort.

02

scents added, no alcohol, less irritation for pets, healthy and safe to use on pets.

03

[household-cleaning-wipes]
][35]

### [Household Using Wipes][36]

Thicker material, larger size, no harsh or caustic formula, safe to use, can be used in the kitchen,
furniture surfaces, metal, fabric surfaces for daily cleaning or for a quick clean for a specific
point.

04

[cooling-wipes]
][37]

### [Daily Care Wipes][38]

For daily care wipes, including men's wipe, adult wipe, deodorant wipes for body odor, flushable
butt / toilet wipe, etc. Gentle formula and plants extract ingredient, with multiple solutions for
wipes and packages, suitable for various scenarios and convenient for on-the-go.

05

[flushable-toilet-wipes]
][39]

biodegradable, flushable, biodegradable material, mild formula without stimulation.

## Why Choose Us

Our Advantages

Whether you are a major brand name, a large supermarket chain, or an online e-commerce, offline
retail store, we offer flexible product solutions for each customer based on their characteristics
and unique needs.

### Experience For Different Business Types

Relying on advanced production facilities and a team of experts, once we have determined every
detail of the solution, we are able to execute it quickly and deliver it in the shortest possible
time, allowing you to maximize your benefits.

##### Fast Delivery & Flexible Delivery Services

We have a professional design team as well as a product photography team, if you have packaging
design or product photography needs, we can assist you with these matters - at the best cost and
quality!

##### Design & Graphic Services Available

Before the formal order, you can get our different samples for free, which is convenient for you to
compare and choose, and at the same time, you can base on the samples to provide a basis for your
decision-making, as well as convenient for you to update your products.

##### Free Samples Available Before The Formal Order

Daxin Group
Daxin Group was founded in 2003 and headquartered in Dalian, Liaoning. It is a national high-tech
enterprise integrating research and development, production, and sales. The group operates a modern
R&D center and three production bases, namely Dalian Daxin Health Nursing Products Co., Ltd., Dalian
Daxin Nonwoven Technology Co., Ltd., and Guizhou Daxin Biotechnology Co., Ltd. The company currently
has three 100,000-level dust-free workshops, two 10,000-level product laboratories, and over sixty
fully automatic production lines.

Adhering to an innovative spirit, Daxin Group continuously researches new technologies and has
accumulated over 70 invention patents. During this process, it has developed more than 2,000
products spanning five major categories, including baby wipes, antibacterial wipes, pet wipes,
functional wipes, and eco-friendly wipes. Its business spans the globe.

requirements and claims. Our R&D team works with you to develop the right kind of formulation(s).

viscose, Lyocell fiber, Bamboo fiber, Cotton/Viscose/PET fabric blends and Viscose/PET fabric blends

individually wrapped wipes for your choice.

### Custom Fragrance

## ITW Pro Brands offers product solutions to keep operations running.

### The voice of our customer is our most valued resource. Through collaboration with end-users, we
### translate needs into value-added product offerings; driving further efficiencies and investing
### that value back into our customers' operations.

## Lubricants

#### Our LPS®, Rustlick™ and Accu-lube® brands offer lubrication products for the most demanding
#### industrial needs. From general purpose, wet or dry film, chain and cable or MQL, we have a
#### product that will deliver on results and minimize costly downtime.

[SEE PRODUCTS][145]

## Corrosion Inhibitors

#### When corrosion and rust are a concern, you can trust LPS® and Rustlick™ products to protect
#### your work. Check out our range of moisture absorbing, displacing and protective coatings and
#### see why investment in prevention saves time and money in the long run.

[SEE PRODUCTS][146]

## Cleaners

#### In addition to SCRUBS in-a-Bucket® Hand Cleaner Towels, we offer a variety of other targeted
#### application cleaners for virtually any industrial cleaning need. From degreasing to electrical
#### cleaners to disinfectants, our products are developed for professionals to deliver quick
#### results that keep operations clean, maintained and running.

[SEE PRODUCTS][147]

## Marking

#### Almost 100 years ago, DYKEM® STEEL BLUE® set the industry standard for layout fluids and we’ve
#### grown to provide a full line of specialty industrial marking products. Whether you need a
#### permanent, removable, high temp, high purity mark or a paste that indicates torque or
#### tampering, depend on DYKEM® to deliver.

[SEE PRODUCTS][148]

## Mold Release

#### Our Diamondkote™ and Crystal mold releases offer innovative formulations and customized
#### solutions. The specific chemistry within our products provide unsurpassed performance for
#### rubber, composite, urethane and plastic molding applications bringing increased efficiency and
#### overall quality to operations.

### The voice of our customer is our most valued resource. Through collaboration with end-users, we
### translate needs into value-added product offerings; driving further efficiencies and investing
### that value back into our customers' operations.

## Lubricants

#### Our LPS®, Rustlick™ and Accu-lube® brands offer lubrication products for the most demanding
#### industrial needs. From general purpose, wet or dry film, chain and cable or MQL, we have a
#### product that will deliver on results and minimize costly downtime.

[SEE PRODUCTS][145]

## Corrosion Inhibitors

#### When corrosion and rust are a concern, you can trust LPS® and Rustlick™ products to protect
#### your work. Check out our range of moisture absorbing, displacing and protective coatings and
#### see why investment in prevention saves time and money in the long run.

[SEE PRODUCTS][146]

## Cleaners

#### In addition to SCRUBS in-a-Bucket® Hand Cleaner Towels, we offer a variety of other targeted
#### application cleaners for virtually any industrial cleaning need. From degreasing to electrical
#### cleaners to disinfectants, our products are developed for professionals to deliver quick
#### results that keep operations clean, maintained and running.

[SEE PRODUCTS][147]

## Marking

#### Almost 100 years ago, DYKEM® STEEL BLUE® set the industry standard for layout fluids and we’ve
#### grown to provide a full line of specialty industrial marking products. Whether you need a
#### permanent, removable, high temp, high purity mark or a paste that indicates torque or
#### tampering, depend on DYKEM® to deliver.

[SEE PRODUCTS][148]

## Mold Release

#### Our Diamondkote™ and Crystal mold releases offer innovative formulations and customized
#### solutions. The specific chemistry within our products provide unsurpassed performance for
#### rubber, composite, urethane and plastic molding applications bringing increased efficiency and
#### overall quality to operations.

# Your Partner in Infection Prevention Since 1985

Our solutions are trusted every day in thousands of healthcare facilities around the world to help
prevent infections and cross-contamination.

[ Learn More ][58]

### CaviCide™ HP

CaviCide™ HP a ready-to-use liquid surface disinfectant utilizing a hydrogen peroxide formulation
that offers a universal 1-minute contact time against all 70 listed pathogens and meets all levels
of the EPA’s rigorous Emerging Viral Pathogen (EVP) claim.

[ Learn More ][59]

##### About Us

## Who We Are

We believe that NO ONE should ever have to fight for their health over an illness they did not have
when they entered a healthcare facility. We work tirelessly to ensure that all people within all
areas of the healthcare environment are properly protected from cross-contamination so focus can be
put on the most important thing: Getting the Patient Better.

[ Learn More ][60]

## Infection Prevention Solutions

**Our products are used in over 100,000 facilities worldwide.**

and Bleach are on EPA List Q.

products designed to high level disinfect heat-sensitive medical instruments.

# Your Partner in Infection Prevention Since 1985

Our solutions are trusted every day in thousands of healthcare facilities around the world to help
prevent infections and cross-contamination.

[ Learn More ][58]

### CaviCide™ HP

CaviCide™ HP a ready-to-use liquid surface disinfectant utilizing a hydrogen peroxide formulation
that offers a universal 1-minute contact time against all 70 listed pathogens and meets all levels
of the EPA’s rigorous Emerging Viral Pathogen (EVP) claim.

[ Learn More ][59]

##### About Us

## Who We Are

We believe that NO ONE should ever have to fight for their health over an illness they did not have
when they entered a healthcare facility. We work tirelessly to ensure that all people within all
areas of the healthcare environment are properly protected from cross-contamination so focus can be
put on the most important thing: Getting the Patient Better.

[ Learn More ][60]

**Our products are used in over 100,000 facilities worldwide.**

## Custom Converting

At National Wiper Alliance®, we utilize several different cutting methods, winding techniques, and
folding methods which allow us to meet even the most demanding converting requirements of the
market.

In addition to several converting techniques, we also offer custom converting services. We can offer
you a Turn Key product, giving you a finished product using National Wiper Alliance® materials and
packaging.

[Learn More][41]


## Our Products

At National Wiper Alliance®, our focus and brand is dry, nonwoven wipes. We serve customers in
diverse industries ranging from food service, healthcare, janitorial, military, automotive, and
aerospace. Our goal is to provide customer-oriented service by offering and producing quality wiping
products to customers worldwide in a timely and efficient manner. Additionally, NWA offers customers
a vast array of converted products based on specific needs and uses. We manufacture these products
in many different types of substrates and put-ups.

[Learn More][42]


## About Us

The name National Wiper Alliance® was created to express our approach to business. ***National***
describes our core market, the United States. ***Wiper** *indicates our product. Finally,
***Alliance***, because we believe that each relationship that we have, to the end user or to other
companies, is an Alliance where we all work together to provide quality to all customers. We feel
strongly that offering quality products in a timely manner will help everyone to benefit.

[Learn More][43]


## Dedicated, Committed, Devoted.
* We are dedicated to manufacturing quality wiping products
* We are committed to fully understanding and meeting the needs and expectations of our customers
* We are dedicated to providing unparalleled customer service from first contact to delivery
* We will remain devoted to the maximum standard of integrity in all our business
* We are committed to providing you with the best solutions for all your non-woven needs

### Surface Disinfectants

Our alcoholic and alcohol-free surface disinfectants are optimised for use in medical facilities.
They offer a broad spectrum of activity and proven compatibility with 250 materials commonly found
in medical and dental practices. Our economical disinfectant concentrates are ideal for larger
surfaces such as floors. Trust in Swiss-made disinfectants, produced on fully automated production
lines.

[ EXPLORE OUR SURFACE DISINFECTANTS › ][81]

### Instruments Disinfectants and Cleaners

Our instrument disinfectants and ultrasonic cleaners ensure a safe and efficient reprocessing of
dental and medical instruments. The products are suitable for use in soaking trays as well as in
ultrasonic cleaning devices. Most of our instrument disinfectants are virucidal and thus inactivate
enveloped as well as non-enveloped viruses. At the same time, they are less corrosive to instruments
than water.

Our alcoholic and alcohol-free surface disinfectants are optimised for use in medical facilities.
They offer a broad spectrum of activity and proven compatibility with 250 materials commonly found
in medical and dental practices. Our economical disinfectant concentrates are ideal for larger

[ EXPLORE OUR SURFACE DISINFECTANTS › ][81]

### Instruments Disinfectants and Cleaners

Our instrument disinfectants and ultrasonic cleaners ensure a safe and efficient reprocessing of

[ EXPLORE OUR INSTRUMENT DISINFECTANTS › ][82]

## Excellent Material Compatibility

Using our surface disinfectants not only protects you and your patients from pathogens, but also
your equipment from damage.

[ FIND OUT MORE › ][83]

The material compatibility of our products has been confirmed by an external, ISO 17025-accredited
laboratory, where over 20,000 disinfection cycles were simulated in extensive tests in accordance
with ISO 21530.


[ FIND OUT MORE › ][84]

## Candida auris

Our disinfectants are effective against the
clinically significant and drug-resistant fungus
Candida auris.

### Geruchsbekämpfung

Sanosil Geruchsneutralisierer beseitigen Gerüche auf molekularer Ebene mit biochemischer Technologie
und sorgen für langanhaltende Frische in industriellen und gewerblichen Umgebungen

[Sanosil water]

## Wasserdesinfektion

Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel gehören durch die Nutzung von speziell stabilisierten und
wirkungsverstärktem Wasserstoffperoxid zu den effektivsten Produkten in diesem Bereich

Die Wirkung vor allem gegenüber Biofilmen, Schleimablagerungen und VBNC Keimen ist dem oft
verwendeten Chlor und Chlordioxid klar und nachweislich überlegen. Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel sind
verglichen mit anderen oxidierenden Bioziden im Wasser auch deutlich länger aktiv und ermöglichen
die Verwendung in langen Leitungssystemen. Es können deshalb tiefere wirksame Konzentrationen
eingesetzt werden, welche dadurch deutlich geringere Korrosionsraten aufweisen. Dies schont
Material, Umwelt und reduziert laufende Kosten. Ein besonderer Pluspunkt der Sanosil
Desinfektionsmittel ist zudem die gute Umweltverträglichkeit des Wirkstoffes Wasserstoffperoxid.
Dieses zersetzt sich während der Desinfektion komplett zu Wasser und Sauerstoff, und im Gegensatz zu
Brom oder Chlor werden keine giftigen Trihalomethane gebildet.


[Disinfected table in a hospital]


## Flächendesinfektion

Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel hinterlassen durch die geringen Menge an Feststoffen auch bei
wiederholtem Einsatz keine klebrigen Rückstände auf den desinfizierten Flächen

Das geboostete Wasserstoffperoxid zerfällt nach der Anwendung zu Wasser und Sauerstoff und weist
deshalb eine gute Umweltverträglichkeit auf. Es werden weder Desinfektionsmittel-, noch
Antibiotikaresistenzen begünstigt. Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel verbreiten auch keine unangenehm
riechende oder gar brennbare Dämpfe.

Die meisten Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel verfügen zudem über eine gewisse Depotwirkung, wodurch die
rasche Wiederverkeimung auf Oberflächen deutlich gehemmt gehemmt wird. Dies macht die Sanosil
Flächen – Desinfektionsmittel zur ideale Wahl für gewerbliche und private Anwender.

[Square---Google-display-ads-V-2]

## Aerosol – Raumdesinfektion

Die Aerosolanwendung ist eine Methode der automatisierten Desinfektion von ganzen Räumen über die
Luft

Dabei werden Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel mit einem geeigneten Gerät automatisch in winzig kleine
Tröpfchen zerstäubt. Diese Aerosole bedecken anschliessend lückenlos alle Oberflächen. So können
gefährliche Lücken geschlossen und die Wirkung der klassische manuelle Sprüh und -Wischdesinfektion
ideal ergänzt werden. Diese Kombination hat sich als eine der wirkungsvollsten Methoden im Kampf
gegen resistente Keime und Krankenhausinfektionen erwiesen.

Auch in der Pharmaindustrie / Reinräumen wird die Verwendung automatisierter, luftgetragener
Desinfektionssysteme im EU GMP Annex 1 explizit erwähnt. Die Anwendung ist aber nicht auf den
Medizin – und Pharmabereich beschränkt. Aerosoldesinfektionen sorgen auch in Hotelräumen, Labors,
Fahrzeugen sowie in Grossraumbüros und Konferenzsäälen für zusätzliche Hygiene und Reduktion
ansteckender Krankheiten.


Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel für die Aerosoldesinfektion bestechen vorallem durch ihr katalytisch
leistungsgesteigertes Wasserstoffperoxid. Deshalb sind sie Systemen mit
Heissdampf-Wasserstoffperoxid, welche deutlich stärkere H2O2 Konzentrationen  verwenden, ebenbürtig.
Bei tieferen Gesamtkosten und einfacherem Handling.

### Geruchsbekämpfung

Sanosil Geruchsneutralisierer beseitigen Gerüche auf molekularer Ebene mit biochemischer Technologie
und sorgen für langanhaltende Frische in industriellen und gewerblichen Umgebungen

[Sanosil water]

## Wasserdesinfektion

Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel gehören durch die Nutzung von speziell stabilisierten und
wirkungsverstärktem Wasserstoffperoxid zu den effektivsten Produkten in diesem Bereich

Die Wirkung vor allem gegenüber Biofilmen, Schleimablagerungen und VBNC Keimen ist dem oft
verwendeten Chlor und Chlordioxid klar und nachweislich überlegen. Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel sind
verglichen mit anderen oxidierenden Bioziden im Wasser auch deutlich länger aktiv und ermöglichen
die Verwendung in langen Leitungssystemen. Es können deshalb tiefere wirksame Konzentrationen
eingesetzt werden, welche dadurch deutlich geringere Korrosionsraten aufweisen. Dies schont
Material, Umwelt und reduziert laufende Kosten. Ein besonderer Pluspunkt der Sanosil
Desinfektionsmittel ist zudem die gute Umweltverträglichkeit des Wirkstoffes Wasserstoffperoxid.
Dieses zersetzt sich während der Desinfektion komplett zu Wasser und Sauerstoff, und im Gegensatz zu
Brom oder Chlor werden keine giftigen Trihalomethane gebildet.


[Disinfected table in a hospital]


## Flächendesinfektion

Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel hinterlassen durch die geringen Menge an Feststoffen auch bei
wiederholtem Einsatz keine klebrigen Rückstände auf den desinfizierten Flächen

Das geboostete Wasserstoffperoxid zerfällt nach der Anwendung zu Wasser und Sauerstoff und weist
deshalb eine gute Umweltverträglichkeit auf. Es werden weder Desinfektionsmittel-, noch
Antibiotikaresistenzen begünstigt. Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel verbreiten auch keine unangenehm
riechende oder gar brennbare Dämpfe.

Die meisten Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel verfügen zudem über eine gewisse Depotwirkung, wodurch die
rasche Wiederverkeimung auf Oberflächen deutlich gehemmt gehemmt wird. Dies macht die Sanosil
Flächen – Desinfektionsmittel zur ideale Wahl für gewerbliche und private Anwender.

[Square---Google-display-ads-V-2]

## Aerosol – Raumdesinfektion

Die Aerosolanwendung ist eine Methode der automatisierten Desinfektion von ganzen Räumen über die
Luft

Dabei werden Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel mit einem geeigneten Gerät automatisch in winzig kleine
Tröpfchen zerstäubt. Diese Aerosole bedecken anschliessend lückenlos alle Oberflächen. So können
gefährliche Lücken geschlossen und die Wirkung der klassische manuelle Sprüh und -Wischdesinfektion
ideal ergänzt werden. Diese Kombination hat sich als eine der wirkungsvollsten Methoden im Kampf
gegen resistente Keime und Krankenhausinfektionen erwiesen.

Auch in der Pharmaindustrie / Reinräumen wird die Verwendung automatisierter, luftgetragener
Desinfektionssysteme im EU GMP Annex 1 explizit erwähnt. Die Anwendung ist aber nicht auf den
Medizin – und Pharmabereich beschränkt. Aerosoldesinfektionen sorgen auch in Hotelräumen, Labors,
Fahrzeugen sowie in Grossraumbüros und Konferenzsäälen für zusätzliche Hygiene und Reduktion
ansteckender Krankheiten.


Sanosil Desinfektionsmittel für die Aerosoldesinfektion bestechen vorallem durch ihr katalytisch
leistungsgesteigertes Wasserstoffperoxid. Deshalb sind sie Systemen mit
Heissdampf-Wasserstoffperoxid, welche deutlich stärkere H2O2 Konzentrationen  verwenden, ebenbürtig.
Bei tieferen Gesamtkosten und einfacherem Handling.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

We analyse customer behaviours, channel economics, and real-world use cases to identify the
segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions
actually drive choice.

Our Thematic & Disruption Research identifies the structural shifts, emerging technologies, new
business models, and macro forces reshaping industries. We decode early signals, model long-term
scenarios, and highlight opportunities and risks-equipping leaders with future-ready insight to
guide strategy, investment, innovation, and organizational resilience.

Deep dives on cross-cutting themes such as sustainability, digital transformation, AI, automation,
circular economy and new revenue models. We connect these themes back to specific industry and
segment opportunities.

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

Our Strategic Revenue Advisory helps organizations make confident, evidence-driven decisions about
where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,
customer behaviour, competitive context, and financial modelling to build a revenue strategy that is
resilient, high-impact, and aligned with long-term growth opportunities.

Support for decisions on where to play, how to win and how fast to move. This includes portfolio
focus, market entry, pricing, partnership strategy and capital allocation grounded in evidence.

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

sources.

indicators.

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

tailored, client-specific solutions.

come up with a protocol, iterate with us and formulate a plan. TestLabs then delivered the project
on time and on budget, while communicating clearly every step of the way. Excellent.

testing. We’re focused on medical devices, we’ve built serious capacity exclusively for medtech, and
we move with urgency. We deliver full test studies faster than competitors can issue quotes – with

## We Are PDI

PDI is dedicated to leading the fight against preventable infections in healthcare, foodservice and
our communities. Driven by a commitment to research, quality and service, PDI provides innovative
products, educational resources, training and support to help prevent infection transmission and
promote health and wellness.

## One PDI Company

[
][62] [

### PDI Healthcare

**PDI Healthcare** offers evidence-based, market leading Interventional Care, Environment of Care
and Patient Care solutions, all designed to help reduce preventable infections, control associated
costs, and ultimately help save lives across the healthcare continuum of care.

Visit Site

][63] [
][64] [

### Tru-D SmartUVC

The **Tru-D** iQ system of connected products adapts to the needs of a wide range of room sizes to
administer a precise dose of UVC. Using Sensor360® technology, Tru-D products provide trusted
disinfection of hard, nonporous surfaces with remarkable speed and proven efficacy.

Visit Site

][65] [
][66] [

### Sani Professional

**Sani Professional** helps save lives through food safety. According to the CDC, 1 in 6 Americans
suffer from a foodborne illness every year. Sani Professional offers solutions to the foodservice
industry that are convenient, effective and user-friendly.

Visit Site

][67] [
][68] [

### Contract Manufacturing

From cosmetic to OTC and Rx products, **PDI Contract Manufacturing** partners with leading consumer
brand and pharma companies to deliver their products in alternate delivery systems. Focusing on the
highest level of quality, let PDI’s expertise work for you.

Visit Site

## We Are PDI

PDI is dedicated to leading the fight against preventable infections in healthcare, foodservice and
our communities. Driven by a commitment to research, quality and service, PDI provides innovative
products, educational resources, training and support to help prevent infection transmission and
promote health and wellness.

and Patient Care solutions, all designed to help reduce preventable infections, control associated
costs, and ultimately help save lives across the healthcare continuum of care.

# Wipes Manufacturer & Supplier for OEM and Private Label Orders

Cleanora Wipes is a China-based wipes manufacturer and supplier for overseas wholesalers, importers,
private label brands, retail chains and project buyers. We supply baby wipes, body care wipes,
makeup remover wipes, flushable wet wipes, industrial wet wipes and private label wipes for OEM and
bulk order projects.

Since 2015, we have supported wipes projects from Yiwu, Zhejiang, with around 12,100 square meters,
6–8 converting and packing lines, sample approval, nonwoven material selection, liquid direction
review, custom packaging and export carton preparation.

[Send Inquiry][68]

### Since 2015

Yiwu-based wipes manufacturing and supply support from Yixi Industrial Zone, Shangxi Town, Jinhua,
Zhejiang, China.

### 6–8 Production Lines

Wet wipes folding, cutting, liquid dosing, sealing, sachet packing, canister support and carton
packing for B2B orders.

### OEM & Private Label

Packaging bag, flip-top lid, wipe size, sheet count, material, GSM, barcode, carton marks and sample
approval support.

### MOQ & Export Support

Standard items usually start from 10,000–30,000 packs. EXW, FOB, CIF and DDP are available by order
plan.

## Main Wipes Categories

Choose the wipes category that matches your target channel, packaging plan and order quantity. Each
product line can be quoted by wipe size, sheet count, nonwoven material, liquid direction, packaging
style, artwork and destination market.
[[Baby Wipes]][69]

### [Baby Wipes][70]

Soft nonwoven baby wipes for baby care brands, importers and private label buyers. Common options
include fragrance-free direction, soft-touch material, retail pouch and refill pack packaging.

[[Body Care Wipes]][71]

### [Body Care Wipes][72]

Body care wipes for hygiene product distributors, personal care brands and retail supply channels.
Wipe size, sheet count, material feel and liquid direction can be matched to buyer use cases.

[[Makeup Wipes]][73]

### [Makeup Wipes][74]

Makeup remover wipes for beauty brands, importers and private label projects. We help confirm wipe
texture, wetness, pouch design, sheet count and sample details before production.

[[Flushable Wet Wipes]][75]

### [Flushable Wet Wipes][76]

Flushable wet wipes for bathroom and personal hygiene channels. Material, dispersibility direction,
label wording and testing needs should be reviewed by target market before order confirmation.

[[Industrial Wet Wipes]][77]

### [Industrial Wet Wipes][78]

Heavy-duty industrial wet wipes for cleaning supply distributors, workshops and project purchasing.
Pack type, material strength, wipe size and carton packing can be matched to bulk use.

**Bulk Disinfecting Wipes & Hand Sanitizing Wipes for Sale**

Wipes.com is a U.S. supplier of bulk disinfecting wipes, hand sanitizing wipes, and no-rinse
food-contact surface wipes for fitness centers, gyms, schools, community centers, healthcare,
hospitality, food service, and other commercial facilities. We specialize in large-roll gym wipes,
wholesale and pallet ordering, and compatible wipe dispensers, with same-day shipping on orders
placed before 2 p.m. ET.

 

**Disinfecting Wipes (surface wipes) **

Our disinfecting wipes are used to kill bacteria and viruses on hard, non-porous surfaces when used
as directed. They're EPA-registered (EPA Reg. No. 1839-190-86745), measure 6" x 8", and come in
800-count rolls, 4 rolls per box (3,200 wipes). Ideal for gym equipment, cardio consoles, benches,
desks, door handles, and other high-touch surfaces. See the product page for the master label,
directions for use, and efficacy data.

 

**CleanQix No-Rinse Food Contact Surface Disinfecting Wipes **

CleanQix wipes are food-contact surface disinfecting wipes designed for kitchens and food-service
environments, where no rinse is required on food-contact surfaces when used according to the
directions for disinfection. They clean and disinfect hard, non-porous surfaces — and may be used on
cutting boards, dishes, and eating utensils without rinsing when used as directed. Built for
restaurants, kitchens, bars, cafeterias, dining areas, food-processing facilities, schools, hotels,
and other institutional settings. CleanQix wipes are EPA-registered (EPA Reg. No. 6836-379-86745)
and come as 2 refill rolls of 800 wipes per box. See the product page for the full label, directions
for use, and complete list of claims.

 

**Hand Sanitizing Wipes (hand wipes) **

Our hand sanitizing wipes are designed for use on hands. They measure 5" x 7" and come in
1,700-count rolls, 4 rolls per box (6,800 wipes) — a convenient bulk alternative to Purell® hand
wipes for high-traffic facilities.

 

All our wipes are made in the USA from high-quality material that won't tear or leave residue or
lint. All rolls fit our dispensers and most competitor large-roll dispensers.

 

**Bulk & Wholesale Ordering **

Buy by the box, case, or pallet. Wholesale and pallet pricing is available for high-volume
facilities, with recurring-shipment options through your online account.

 

Shipping Orders placed before 2 p.m. ET ship the same day; orders after 2 p.m. ET ship the next
business day.

What's the difference between disinfecting wipes and hand sanitizing wipes?

Disinfecting wipes are used on hard, non-porous surfaces to kill bacteria and viruses when used as
directed. Hand sanitizing wipes are designed for use on hands. Most facilities use disinfecting
wipes on shared equipment and keep hand sanitizing wipes on hand for members and staff.

 

**What are no-rinse food-contact wipes? **

No-rinse food-contact wipes are surface disinfecting wipes rated for use on surfaces that touch
food, without a rinse step afterward, when used according to the directions for disinfection.

**Bulk Disinfecting Wipes & Hand Sanitizing Wipes for Sale**

Wipes.com is a U.S. supplier of bulk disinfecting wipes, hand sanitizing wipes, and no-rinse
food-contact surface wipes for fitness centers, gyms, schools, community centers, healthcare,
hospitality, food service, and other commercial facilities. We specialize in large-roll gym wipes,
wholesale and pallet ordering, and compatible wipe dispensers, with same-day shipping on orders
placed before 2 p.m. ET.

 

**Disinfecting Wipes (surface wipes) **

Our disinfecting wipes are used to kill bacteria and viruses on hard, non-porous surfaces when used
as directed. They're EPA-registered (EPA Reg. No. 1839-190-86745), measure 6" x 8", and come in
800-count rolls, 4 rolls per box (3,200 wipes). Ideal for gym equipment, cardio consoles, benches,
desks, door handles, and other high-touch surfaces. See the product page for the master label,
directions for use, and efficacy data.

 

**CleanQix No-Rinse Food Contact Surface Disinfecting Wipes **

CleanQix wipes are food-contact surface disinfecting wipes designed for kitchens and food-service
environments, where no rinse is required on food-contact surfaces when used according to the
directions for disinfection. They clean and disinfect hard, non-porous surfaces — and may be used on
cutting boards, dishes, and eating utensils without rinsing when used as directed. Built for
restaurants, kitchens, bars, cafeterias, dining areas, food-processing facilities, schools, hotels,
and other institutional settings. CleanQix wipes are EPA-registered (EPA Reg. No. 6836-379-86745)
and come as 2 refill rolls of 800 wipes per box. See the product page for the full label, directions
for use, and complete list of claims.

 

**Hand Sanitizing Wipes (hand wipes) **

Our hand sanitizing wipes are designed for use on hands. They measure 5" x 7" and come in
1,700-count rolls, 4 rolls per box (6,800 wipes) — a convenient bulk alternative to Purell® hand
wipes for high-traffic facilities.

 

All our wipes are made in the USA from high-quality material that won't tear or leave residue or
lint. All rolls fit our dispensers and most competitor large-roll dispensers.

 

**Bulk & Wholesale Ordering **

Buy by the box, case, or pallet. Wholesale and pallet pricing is available for high-volume
facilities, with recurring-shipment options through your online account.

 

Shipping Orders placed before 2 p.m. ET ship the same day; orders after 2 p.m. ET ship the next
business day.

What's the difference between disinfecting wipes and hand sanitizing wipes?

Disinfecting wipes are used on hard, non-porous surfaces to kill bacteria and viruses when used as
directed. Hand sanitizing wipes are designed for use on hands. Most facilities use disinfecting
wipes on shared equipment and keep hand sanitizing wipes on hand for members and staff.

 

**What are no-rinse food-contact wipes? **

No-rinse food-contact wipes are surface disinfecting wipes rated for use on surfaces that touch
food, without a rinse step afterward, when used according to the directions for disinfection.
